arguments.lyrics:
[Hook - one short line per bar; four clear beats; immediate singing]
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!

[Echo - same two-note melody; short sung response, light backing]
Meow, meow! (Meow, meow!)
Woof, woof! (Woof, woof!)
Meow, meow! (Meow, meow!)
Woof, woof! (Woof, woof!)

[Hook - repeat the exact catchy melody and rhythm]
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!

[Clap hook - same rhythmic pattern, handclaps on beats two and four]
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!
Clap, clap! Meow, meow!
Clap, clap! Woof, woof!

[Hook - unchanged simple melody; make the beat springier, not faster]
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!

[Echo - easy responses with space between words]
Meow, meow! (Meow, meow!)
Woof, woof! (Woof, woof!)
Meow, meow! (Meow, meow!)
Woof, woof! (Woof, woof!)

[Final hook - keep the same tune; no extra words]
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!
Cat, cat! Meow, meow!
Dog, dog! Woof, woof!

[Short sung ending - resolve and stop; no restart]
Cat! Meow, meow!
Dog! Woof, woof!
[End]
arguments.style: Preserve the source recording's bright light feminine lead voice and warm preschool tone. Refine its rhythmic hook rather than changing genre. Around 118 BPM, bouncy simple nursery dance for ages 2-4. One stable two-note singalong motif, exactly repeated. Cat-cat then meow-meow; dog-dog then woof-woof. Four clear syllable pulses in each bar, short breaths between calls and responses, never rushed. Punchy dry handclaps on beats 2 and 4, round springy bass, short bright marimba plucks, light kick and shaker. More infectious rhythmic bounce and a memorable repeat, sparse backing so every word is clear. Lead sings the words; small soft echo doubles only. Vocal within one second. Continuous sung sections, no instrumental break. Finish the last sung tag naturally and stop within about 70-75 seconds, short final chord, no long outro.
arguments.negative_style: new male lead, adult crooning, breathy pop diva, big choir, belting, elaborate melody, melisma, fast tongue twisters, busy percussion fills, spoken narration, long instrumental gaps, long outro, abrupt cutoff
